content_fields.title: Verify that signed image enforcement is enabled (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that signed image enforcement is actually in effect.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means attempting to run an unsigned image and confirming the platform refuses it, then confirming a signed image runs.
content_fields.found: No enforcement mechanism is configured, so the negative test would pass trivially.
content_fields.missing: The enforcement layer that would be the subject of the test.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification depends on platform enforcement that does not yet exist.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should perform this verification after enabling content trust.
